sentences.text:
Learned APP, on instructions from the Investigating Officer (IO), who is present in Court,
submits that both the applicants have been cooperating pursuant to notices issued to them under Section 41A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Cr.P.C.).
4.
In light of the above, the Court is of the considered view that the applicants are entitled to grant of anticipatory bail.

Consequently, in the event of arrest in FIR No. 40/2023, the applicants be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- each with one surety of the like amount, subject to the satisfaction of the arresting officer/Station House Officer (SHO)
concerned and further subject to the condition that the applicants shall join the investigation as and when directed and not influence any witness/complainant or tamper with the evidence of the case.
5. The applications stand disposed of in above terms.
